name: Neon Snake
description: The classic snake in glowing neon: swipe to turn, eat the lights and chase bonus orbs.
prompt: A neon snake game with swipe controls and arrow buttons, glowing food, pink bonus orbs that disappear, walls or wrap-around mode, three speeds and a saved best score.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: La serpiente de siempre en neón: desliza para girar, cómete las luces y persigue las esferas de bonus.
